jobs.title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
jobs.description:
Principal AI Engineer – Voice AI & Clinical Intelligence

Cohera Health | San Francisco Bay Area | Full-Time

About Cohera Health Cohera Health is building the AI operating system for healthcare.

We're developing intelligent AI agents that transform how healthcare practices operate, from answering patient calls and scheduling appointments to automating clinical documentation and improving the quality of care.

Our platform combines conversational Voice AI, clinical documentation intelligence, and deep EHR integrations to eliminate administrative friction for healthcare providers.
We're an early-stage, venture-backed healthcare AI company working with large healthcare organizations to bring production-grade AI into real clinical environments.

The Opportunity We're hiring an exceptional Principal AI Engineer
to help lead the architecture, development, and optimization of our core AI products.
This is a highly technical, hands-on engineering role for someone who has built and scaled sophisticated AI applications in production.
You'll work directly with our CTO and engineering team to solve complex challenges involving real-time voice conversations, speech recognition, LLM orchestration, clinical documentation, and intelligent healthcare workflows.
We are looking for a builder—not someone who simply manages AI projects or connects APIs.

What You'll Build 1. Voice AI — Aria Admin

Develop and continuously improve our enterprise Voice AI platform that handles patient conversations and automates healthcare front-desk workflows.
Architect real-time, low-latency, natural voice conversations.
Optimize speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and speech-to-speech technologies.
Build intelligent conversational workflows for patient intake, scheduling, insurance verification, and administrative requests.
Improve interruption handling, turn-taking, contextual awareness, and conversational accuracy.
Develop robust LLM orchestration, tool calling, and multi-step agent workflows.
Reduce voice latency, hallucinations, and unnecessary escalations.
Optimize inference performance, token consumption, and cost per conversation.
Build reliable, production-grade voice agents capable of handling high call volumes.

2. Clinical AI — Aria Chart

Architect and improve our AI-powered clinical documentation platform.
Build and optimize ambient medical scribe capabilities for in-person and telehealth encounters.
Improve medical transcription accuracy, speaker diarization, and clinical terminology recognition.
Develop LLM pipelines that transform patient-provider conversations into structured clinical documentation.
Build intelligent clinical note generation using specialty-specific templates and clinician preferences.
Develop contextual intelligence using historical patient notes and relevant chart data.
Improve accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability of AI-generated clinical notes.
Optimize real-time transcription pipelines, processing speed, and infrastructure cost.
Support AI-powered clinical documentation auditing and CPT coding guidance.

3. AI Architecture & Engineering

Own critical architectural decisions across our Voice AI and Clinical AI products.
Design and implement scalable AI systems using modern LLMs, speech models, and agent frameworks.
Evaluate emerging AI models and technologies to improve accuracy, latency, reliability, and cost.
Build AI evaluation frameworks, automated testing, monitoring, and observability.
Implement robust safeguards against hallucinations, prompt injection, unsafe outputs, and workflow failures.
Partner with engineering, product, and clinical leadership to bring new AI capabilities into production.
Mentor engineers and establish engineering best practices as we scale.

What We're Looking For Required Qualifications

8–12+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience building AI/ML-powered applications.
Deep expertise with Python and production backend engineering.
Strong hands-on experience with LLMs, agent architectures, prompt engineering, tool calling, and structured outputs.
Experience building and operating production systems involving real-time audio, speech processing, or conversational AI.
Strong understanding of STT/TTS systems, streaming architectures, and low-latency inference.
Experience with LLM evaluation, model selection, performance optimization, and production monitoring.
Expertise in scalable cloud architectures, APIs, distributed systems, and data pipelines.
Demonstrated ability to take complex AI products from prototype to reliable production deployment.
Strong engineering judgment, ownership mentality, and ability to work in a fast-moving startup environment.

Highly Desirable Experience

Building real-time voice agents using technologies such as Deepgram, ElevenLabs, Twilio, LiveKit, or similar platforms.
Working with OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, or open-source foundation models.
Clinical NLP, medical speech recognition, ambient documentation, or healthcare AI.
Developing multi-agent systems, RAG pipelines, or contextual memory architectures.
Fine-tuning, distillation, model serving, and inference optimization.
Healthcare interoperability, including EHR integrations, HL7, and FHIR.
Working with HIPAA-sensitive data and building secure, auditable AI systems.

What Success Looks Like Within your first 6 months, you'll help us:
Deliver highly reliable, natural-sounding Voice AI with low conversational latency.
Significantly improve transcription and clinical note generation quality.
Increase autonomous scheduling completion and reduce avoidable human handoffs.
Improve clinician adoption and reduce documentation editing time.
Reduce AI infrastructure and inference costs without compromising quality.
Establish an architecture capable of supporting large, multi-location healthcare enterprises.

Why Join Cohera Health? Build meaningful AI:
Your work will directly improve the daily experiences of clinicians, patients, and healthcare organizations.
Real-world scale:
We're deploying AI into complex, high-volume healthcare environments.
Technical ownership:
You'll have meaningful influence over our architecture, technology decisions, and product direction.
Exceptional learning opportunity:
Work across conversational AI, clinical intelligence, LLMs, and healthcare integrations.
Startup impact:
Join at an early stage and help shape the technical foundation of a growing healthcare AI company.
Competitive compensation:
Salary, equity, and benefits commensurate with experience.

Who Thrives Here You're someone who loves tackling difficult engineering problems.
You understand that building a demo is easy compared to building AI that consistently works in production.

You care deeply about performance, precision, scalability, and reliability.
And you want your engineering work to make a measurable impact on healthcare.
**If you've built sophisticated Voice AI, LLM, or AI-powered products at scale, we'd love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Founding Research Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

FlowGen Labs is a frontier enterprise AI company building the zero-touch enterprise: context-aware agents that operate inside deeply customized SAP environments at machine speed, grounded in each company’s ontology, live operational data, and operating procedures so complex workflows can run autonomously instead of relying on manual support teams. FlowGen is focused on turning legacy ERP from a system of record into an execution layer for finance and operations. Deployed at Fortune 500 companies across CPG, distribution, high tech, and oil and gas, FlowGen Labs brings together a frontier AI and SAP team from DeepMind, SAP, Meta AI, and Amazon AGI Labs.

Role Summary

You will own a zero-to-one product and its infrastructure. You will build the secure connector and runtime that understands complex enterprise systems, the tooling experience developers use every day, and the analysis and planning engine that transforms legacy code. You will work directly with customers on high-leverage projects and help define our culture, our engineering bar, and our roadmap.

Design the agentic layer. Implement self-checking, reflection, and verification passes before results reach humans or downstream systems.
Experience orchestrating agentic workflows and retrieval augmented generation. Familiarity with LangGraph is a plus.
Stand up inference paths with low latency serving and token-level observability
Productionize prompt pipelines, retrieval, and light fine-tuning, where it moves the needle
Hands-on use of AI tools with clear ideas for applying AI to development, testing, data, and support.
Ownership mentality, crisp communication, and comfortable making decisions with 80 percent information.
Move fast without breaking things, not afraid to learn new stacks, bring a we will figure it out attitude.

Why Join

Direct product and company impact with minimal bureaucracy.
High bar for craft, velocity, and pragmatic shipping.

Logistics

Location: In person, San Francisco Bay Area
Visa Support/Sponsorship available

Compensation Range: $200K - $375K

jobs.title: Research Scientist, Machine Learning & Signal Processing [Technical Leadership]
jobs.description:
Meta is seeking a Research Scientist to lead applied AI initiatives at the intersection of wearable technology and AI modeling of diverse sensors, including EMG, motion sensors, audio, and video. In this role, you will define and drive the scientific agenda for a team of AI research scientists, computational neuroscientists, and machine learning engineers, shaping the direction of next-generation AI capabilities that power Meta's wearable devices and health-focused experiences. You will operate at the frontier of AI research for human-computer interaction, translating scientific advances in biosignal interpretation into scalable systems with measurable product impact.

Research Scientist, Machine Learning & Signal Processing [Technical Leadership] Responsibilities:

Define and drive the research strategy and roadmap for an AI research team focused on wearables, EMG, and wearable sensors, balancing applied machine learning investments with product deliverables
Lead the development of novel AI architectures, training methodologies, and evaluation frameworks for EMG signal processing, sensor fusion, and wearable device intelligence
Establish technical direction for the team by identifying high-impact research problems in sensor signal interpretation and wearable AI, scoping projects, and aligning efforts to broader organizational priorities
Build and grow a high-performing team of AI researchers and engineers through hiring, mentorship, and structured development of research talent
Collaborate with product, engineering, and hardware partners to translate research breakthroughs in EMG and sensing into production wearable systems at Meta's scale
Drive promising research outcomes from research to production, ensuring innovative findings are successfully transitioned into scalable wearable products and features
Communicate research findings and strategic recommendations to organizational leaders and cross-functional stakeholders through written reports, presentations, and design reviews
Foster a team culture that values scientific rigor, engineering craft, and responsible AI development in alignment with Meta's values and compliance standards

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
12+ years of experience in AI or machine learning research, including experience leading research teams or large-scale research programs
Experience establishing research strategy and roadmaps with demonstrated impact on AI systems or products at scale
Experience attracting, developing, and retaining research talent, including building leadership pipelines through internal development and external hiring
Track record of executing cross-functional AI research initiatives from ideation through deployment, including managing dependencies across engineering, product, and data science teams
Experience communicating complex AI research directions and technical decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences through written and verbal formats

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience publishing AI, machine learning, or biosignal processing research in peer-reviewed venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, IEEE EMBC, or similar venues
Experience leading research in one or more specialized domains, such as EMG signal processing, wearable computing, health sensors, human-computer interaction, or physiological signal analysis

About Meta:

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.

Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations-ext@meta.com.

$219,000/year to $301,000/year + bonus + equity + benefits

Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.
